queries: Gary Marcus "these timelines of two to three years" "sniff"

sources_considered.why: Read with read_page, which marked it FULL TEXT. Used only to verify the wording and its qualification, not as evidence that Marcus was right.

evidence_items.locator: Footnote 1, opening sentence of the passage attributed to summer 2025

receipt.public_excerpt: To my mind, these timelines of two to three years don’t even pass the sniff test.

evidence_items.explanation: The author reproduces his earlier judgment with an explicit personal qualification. This establishes the claim's wording, not the accuracy of his assessment.

unresolved_gaps: The claim supplies no reproducible standard for deciding whether a timeline passes its plausibility test.
A categorical no-AGI forecast cannot be inferred without adding a stronger commitment.
